summary: Pioneer Acquisition I Corp, a Cayman blank-check company trading on Nasdaq (PACH/PACHU/PACHW), filed an 8-K disclosing an October 6, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with Green AI Cloud, Inc., a Delaware corporation. The structure involves a Cayman-to-Delaware domestication, a sponsor Class B-to-Class A share conversion, and merger of Merger Sub into Green AI Cloud, which survives as a wholly owned subsidiary. The excerpt omits key economics such as valuation, exchange ratio, minimum cash condition, and closing timeline. Watch for the proxy/registration statement, redemption levels, PIPE financing, and regulatory approvals as risk-arb catalysts.
